versions.changelog:
Initial release of the industry research assistant skill.

- Provides structured industry research using leading frameworks (PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces, SCP, SWOT, supply-demand analysis, cycle assessment).
- Guides users to define objectives, select frameworks, and extract key indicators.
- Outputs customizable, structured research reports tailored to user needs.
- Covers key use cases including market research, competitive analysis, and strategic planning.
